request.state:
Nacre School attendance policy, revision 2026-2. A guardian notice excuses an absence if it is operative before the scheduled class start. A guardian may withdraw a notice before that start; a withdrawn notice is then treated as absent. Reinstatement is a new notice and uses its own receipt time. Messages sent after the scheduled start cannot satisfy the advance-notice route, although the separate emergency-review route may be used when an emergency is documented. Office acknowledgements record receipt only and do not prevent withdrawal.

For Toma's 09:00 class, a guardian submitted “Toma will be absent; please excuse” at 07:30. The office acknowledged it at 07:42. At 08:10 the same authenticated guardian wrote, “Please disregard my excuse; Toma will attend.” Toma did not attend. At 09:20 the guardian wrote, “I should not have withdrawn it; please use the first message.” No emergency or documentation is claimed. The attendance screen still shows the 07:30 message first because it sorts by conversation start.

decision.instructions: Is the absence excused under the guardian-notice rule?
